catalogPolicy.requestedGroups: get_capabilities.requestedGroups 只请求下一安全模型调用的候选挂载，不解除用户设置、联网、费用或服务能力限制。
catalogPolicy.dynamicValidation: 模型/采样器/参考能力/图片操作/倍率由 capability catalog 投影约束；host 不 fallback、clamp 或静默丢参数。
catalogPolicy.hostInjected: defaultMessageTarget/allowedTargetScopes/operationKey/submissionKey/userIntentRef/account binding/attachment registry/CAS snapshot 由 host 注入；targetConversationId/targetCreationId 是可选模型目标引用，不能扩大 allowedTargetScopes。modelFields 与 hostInjectedFields 分列。
catalogPolicy.idempotency: submissionKey/operationKey 由 host 按冻结提交意图或 toolCallId 分配，模型不得生成。
catalogPolicy.attachmentIdentity: 图片输出统一携带 artifactId、attachmentId、attachmentRevision、hash、outputIndex、conversationId、creationId、parentAttachmentId；attachmentId 可直接作为后续工具输入。
catalogPolicy.referencePolicy: discussion bindings require includeInGeneration=false and forbid referencePurpose; role=reference requires one referencePurpose value; all other roles forbid it. role=reference is classification, not consent. includeInGeneration=true is a requested state, never proof of authorization: preserve it only when the expectedInputRevision has active, unrevoked authorization for the exact same target, attachmentId/attachmentRevision, role=reference, and referencePurpose, or when the same userIntentRef traces to a user's explicit opt-in for that exact reference, target, purpose, and authorization scope. A purpose change alone does not authorize generation; it defaults to false unless the same directive explicitly opts in to the new purpose. Host must preserve the source user event and independently validate actual service support.
catalogPolicy.executionInputVersion: Three immutable stages: (1) OriginalMessageSnapshot is frozen when the user submits the message; (2) only a successful, authorized same-turn/same-intent/same-target CAS patch receipt may advance TurnEffectiveInputSnapshot while preserving the original snapshot; (3) prepare/approval/enqueue binds a separate immutable execution snapshot and host-injects frozenInputRevision from its effective revision. Later UI edits cannot hot-change that execution snapshot.

targetSelection.pairRule: 两者同时出现或同时省略；显式目标必须与冻结消息/卡片 allowedTargetScopes 中的同一对匹配。
targetSelection.default: 缺省使用用户发送该消息时冻结的 message/card target，不读取 UI active。
targetSelection.result: 结果 conversationId/creationId 是 host 已解析的真实目标，不回显未经校验的模型值。

referencePurposePolicy.hostCapabilityCheck: referencePurpose describes creative intent only; host must independently verify the selected provider/model supports the requested reference behavior and reject unsupported combinations without fallback.

sourceFindings.finding: 旧 schema 使用 nested args；reference item additionalProperties=true；legacy schema 暴露被 parser 忽略的 scale/qualityToggle。
实际解析器支持动态 model/sampler、尺寸≤2048、CFG≤10、Vibe/precise/character refs；host 需对不支持值拒绝。
当前检索/元数据/同步图像/模板/记忆 handler；gallery 仅 4 source，safeOnly 被旧 Pi schema 漏掉。
旧 preparation consume 和 tool execute 同步耦合；异步 accepted 需持久 ExecutionService。
兼容服务只 text-to-image，允许 positivePrompt/count/model，不可静默回退 NovelAI。
模板操作含 expectedRevision 与确认/备份；templateVersion 是 v5/v4.5，不是正文 revision。

ExecutionSubmissionContext.description: Host-only immutable context shared by generate_image, redraw_image, inpaint_image, upscale_image, and process_image. It is not part of model input.

preflightEnvelope.business: resultKind=business requires data and preserves factual post-dispatch errors/unknowns in tool-specific fields; outer status may reflect actual tool-call failure.
preflightEnvelope.preflight_failure: Only rejection before business side effects: status denied/cancelled/blocked/error; error required; data forbidden; unavailable business identifiers omitted.

turnEffectiveInputSnapshot.advanceOnly: successful authorized CAS patch receipt with same user turn, userIntentRef, and target pair

executionAggregate.outputCardinality: For every readStatus=ok snapshot, outputs contains exactly expectedOutputCount items with unique contiguous outputIndex values 0..N-1, regardless of executionStatus.
executionAggregate.unknownPriority: Any dispatched unknown output or provider receipt has first priority: executionStatus=unknown, even beside pending, completed, cancelled, failed, or not_dispatched siblings. Preserve every item status and stop future dispatch.
executionAggregate.inFlightPriority: If no unknown evidence exists, any pending output or pending provider receipt requires executionStatus=running or cancel_requested. A future dispatch gate never hides active in-flight work.
executionAggregate.dispatching: dispatching means the host has submitted a durable dispatcher claim but has not yet recorded pending or unknown provider/output evidence. In per-output mode it may coexist only with confirmed completed prior outputs and remaining not_dispatched outputs; any prior failed or cancelled output is a stop gate and forbids a later claim. Recovery must inspect the claim/receipt and must not auto-send again. Durable claim identity and recovery behavior are host requirements not expressible or verified by the current result fields/static validator.
executionAggregate.queued: queued requires every output not_dispatched, providerReceiptStatus=not_applicable, and a pauseReason. pauseReason=none means ordinary FIFO queueing; a nonempty blockedReason requires a real hold reason, never pauseReason=none.
executionAggregate.completed: completed requires every expected output completed and providerReceiptStatus=confirmed, with no unknown/pending evidence or active dispatch gate; not_applicable means no provider request and cannot accompany completed output.
executionAggregate.partial: partial requires all indexed outputs terminal and known, at least one completed output plus at least one failed/cancelled/not_dispatched output, providerReceiptStatus=confirmed, and no unknown/pending evidence or active gate. Failed outputs require provider_error or attachment_unavailable.
executionAggregate.zeroSuccess: With no completed outputs, known failed outputs outrank cancellations and resolve to error; every failed output requires a known failure code and error requires providerReceiptStatus=confirmed. Cancellation-only outcomes with at least one cancelled output resolve to cancelled; local queued cancellation may use providerReceiptStatus=not_applicable. blocked requires all outputs not_dispatched, providerReceiptStatus=not_applicable, and blockedReason. denied requires all outputs not_dispatched, providerReceiptStatus=not_applicable, no blockedReason, and a persisted authorization-denial decision. Never infer error/blocked/denied merely from the absence of pending outputs.
executionAggregate.dispatchGate: A present blockedReason is the current gate preventing future dispatch, not historical error text; omit it once the gate clears and retain history in the event log. It may coexist with running or cancel_requested while pending outputs remain. Known failed output evidence beside pending work uses prior_paid_failure; do not mislabel it unknown_prior_receipt. executionStatus=blocked is a distinct whole-execution terminal outcome and requires all outputs not_dispatched, providerReceiptStatus=not_applicable, and blockedReason.
executionAggregate.denialEvidenceLimit: The existing result fields can carry executionStatus=denied and prove no output/provider dispatch, but contain no authorization-denial receipt reference; this validator cannot independently prove persistence or source of the authorization decision.
executionAggregate.batchRequest: After a batch provider request is pending, confirmed, or unknown, an output cannot be claimed not_dispatched; absent/unreceipted output outcomes must remain pending or unknown.
executionAggregate.cancelledOutput: Every output with status=cancelled requires errorCode=cancelled. For a terminal cancelled execution, outputs may only be cancelled/not_dispatched and at least one must be cancelled; providerReceiptStatus=not_applicable is reserved for local pre-dispatch cancellation.
executionAggregate.blocked: executionStatus=blocked is a whole-execution terminal outcome and requires every output not_dispatched, providerReceiptStatus=not_applicable, and a nonempty blockedReason.
executionAggregate.denied: executionStatus=denied requires every output not_dispatched, providerReceiptStatus=not_applicable, no active blockedReason, and a persisted authorization-denial decision; current fields do not include its receipt reference.
executionAggregate.cancelIntent: Cancellation intent is persisted by the host independently from executionStatus and is not a model-visible field. While status=dispatching and no provider-send evidence exists, keep executionStatus=dispatching; cancel_execution may return cancelDisposition=requested with providerCancellation=not_sent. Before sending, the dispatcher checks the intent and confirms local termination if cancellation won. Only after a pending output proves an in-flight provider request may get_execution project cancel_requested. If recovery cannot determine whether the request was sent, project unknown and do not resend.
executionAggregate.failedOutput: Every output whose status is failed carries errorCode=provider_error or attachment_unavailable in every aggregate stage. provider_unknown belongs to status=unknown, not a known failure. A known failed output beside pending work keeps executionStatus=running/cancel_requested and requires blockedReason=prior_paid_failure so future paid dispatch is stopped without hiding the in-flight output.

semanticContracts.requestGranularity: provider request granularity is per_output or batch; output item count is distinct from provider request count; batch results cannot claim an individually missing output was never sent.

seedSemantics.perOutput: resolvedSeed/resolvedSeedSource remain per completed output and require verified provider receipt or embedded metadata; unknown evidence is null/null

semanticContracts.simulationBoundary: Schema and semantic fixtures use fixed examples only. They do not execute product handlers, prove zero side effects, validate providers, or claim paid API behavior.

referenceParticipation.requestedValueIsNotAuthorization: patch_creation_inputs.includeInGeneration=true is a requested state only; the model field cannot grant permission.
referenceParticipation.preserveExisting: True may be preserved only when expectedInputRevision matches the current snapshot and the exact target, attachmentId/attachmentRevision, role=reference, and referencePurpose match an active, unrevoked includeInGeneration=true authorization at that revision. A purpose-only edit does not carry authorization to the new purpose.
referenceParticipation.explicitOptIn: Otherwise true requires the same userIntentRef supplied by the host to trace to an explicit user instruction or UI action authorizing that exact reference to participate in generation, bound to the resolved conversation/creation target, attachment identity, role=reference, new purpose, and authorization scope. The host preserves the source user event and its revision.
referenceParticipation.roleChange: A role change defaults to includeInGeneration=false; true is allowed only when that same explicit directive opts in the exact reference.
referenceParticipation.falseTransition: Setting includeInGeneration=false is always a valid revocation request subject to the normal target/ownership/CAS checks.
referenceParticipation.evidenceLimit: The current model input/result schema has no user-event or permission field. Offline schema/transition fixtures can check the rule against synthetic host evidence, but cannot authenticate event provenance or prove that the user actually opted in.
